name: remote-dev-submit
description: Submit one C++17 file and custom inputs to the controlled runner.

commands.title: Remote Dev: 提交并运行 C++
Remote Dev: 此功能已被管理员禁用

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension.js && esbuild src/contracts.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/contracts.mjs && esbuild src/workspace-policy.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/workspace-policy.mjs && esbuild src/credential.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/credential.mjs
